Class Defaults

java.lang.Object
common.Defaults
All Implemented Interfaces:
CommonConstants, EngineNodeConstants
public class Defaults extends Object implements CommonConstants

Title: Simulation Defaults

Description: This class will provide methods to get default values of every parameter that can be set by the user. Default values can be overridden and will be saved on a config file.

Author:
Bertoli Marco Date: 12-lug-2005 Time: 14.04.02 Modified by Francesco D'Aquino 15/11/2005 Modified by Ashanka (July 2010) Desc: Added new defaults control of a Random CheckBox.
